"IT guy was tasked to update the servers of the facility to ensure that the creatures contained below won't escape. During the update and while the IT guy is updating the security and saving his progress. Doors OS had a system update causing the update to fail. A cascading event causes a failure on the containment systems causing the escape of all the creatures in the facility." - Artist
